title: State-Word Cells in the Summary Tape
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb N$, let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes and states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and let a table word, summary symbol, state word, integer head positions, and output list be given. For every integer $z\ge -1$, the symbol on the summary tape of the resulting round configuration at cell $2+z$ is the symbol stored by the buffer tape for the state word at cell $z$.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $c$ of a $k$-work-tape machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
